title: An explicit exact Hausdorff gauge for SLE
main_claim: Fix 0<kappa<8, with d=1+kappa/8 and p=2-d. Take the gauge h(r)=r^d (log log 1/r)^{p/2}. Then, almost surely, every positive-time compact segment of chordal SLE_kappa has positive finite H^h-measure, and E H^h(trace ∩ B(0,R)) < infinity. As a corollary, Schramm's suggested gauge r^d log log(1/r) is not sigma-finite on any such segment.
coverage:
I read the introduction and main theorem, and all of mesh-tails.tex: Prop mesh:tail, the boundary-layer Green lemma, the kappa<=4 bracket built from asynchronous starts, the disjoint-window concentration lemma and the kappa>4 recurrence. I also read all of retained-mass.tex (bad-square removal, Paley-Zygmund, weak limit with the ball bound, restarting on capacity slots, the sausage lower tail) and all of dense-cover.tex (the bounded-region charge lemma, the single-mesh cover, the missed-cell bound, the greedy disjoint charge, the all-time limit). In ribbon.tex I read the setup, Lemma rc:step with the full contradiction/compactness proof, Lemma es:guide-compactness, the semicircle lemma and Prop rc:dense.

What I checked by hand or computer:
- The Green-decrease identity -dK = 4 Y(z)Y(w)/(|Z(z)|^2|Z(w)|^2), checked numerically with sympy.
- The slab tail exponent delta^{-2} q^{-(2-2p)j}/(j+1)^4.
- The kappa>4 failure exponent (eq win:failure-exponent).
- The recurrence constants alpha_j and e_j, and the U_j iteration.
- The passage from the delta tail to the u^{2/p} tail.
- The bad-square bound l^{p+d} k^{-cD^{2/p}}, summed over l^{-2} squares.
- The cover arithmetic: m_n ~ c0 sqrt(log n) gives success probability n^{-1/2}, failure exp(-c sqrt n), and a cleanup cost that tends to 0 using p+d=2.
- In the ribbon, mass m^2 * ell^d = m^p with probability q^{O(m^2)}.
- The tilt comparison s_1^{a0} and the radius cutoff C1 > 1/c2.
- The quantifier logic of the contradiction proof of rc:step.

Not verified line by line: geometry.tex and local-laws.tex (one-point approach bound, finite tilts, disk rule for kappa>4, localization), which I took as inputs. I also only spot-checked the deeper parts of the step-lemma compactness transfer.
